# Admin localStorage — inventory and elimination plan

**Date:** 2026-08-02 · **Generated by:** `npm run audit:storage`
**Status:** inventory complete · ratchet live in `predeploy` · **45 keys still to migrate**

Related: [[Admin Console Integrity]] · [[Properties Data Source]] · [[Platform Constitution]]

---

## Why this matters, in one sentence

`localStorage` is per-origin **and per device**: what one administrator sees is not what another sees,
and what a customer writes reaches neither.

Three panes proved it independently:

| pane | what the key did |
|---|---|
| **Orders** | the dispute button wrote `localStorage` only — the status change never reached Firestore and was discarded by the next snapshot |
| **Users** | `sokoniAllUsers` had one reader and one writer and **nothing ever populated it**, so the pane said *"No users found"* permanently while 61 accounts sat in Firestore |
| **Properties** | approving a BnB listing changed nothing any host, guest or other admin could see |

## Classification rule

A key is **KEEP** only if losing it, or another device holding a different value, **cannot change a
business outcome**. "It looks like UI" is not a reason. Everything else is **REPLACE** until proven
otherwise — the default is deliberately hostile, because every one of the three failures above looked
harmless in the source.

looks like here.

## The scale, stated plainly

The five-pane programme fixed **four** keys. There are **45 left**, and they span the whole platform:
appointments, bookings, car fleet, commissions, community posts, costs, deliveries, disputes, drivers,
flash sales, ground slots, healthcare facilities, landlord properties, lawyer applications, legal
bookings, medical orders, applications, points, POS orders, promo codes, referrals, returns, reviews,
seller ratings, service providers, subscriptions, tax payments, teams and verified sellers.

Each is the same defect the three panes above had. Several are financial —
`sokoniCommissionLedger`, `sokoniCommissions`, `sokoniTaxPayments`, `sokoniCosts`, `sokoniBookingFees`,
`sokoniLeadFees` — and those should be prioritised, because a commission or tax figure that differs per
device is worse than a listing that does.

## The guard

`scripts/audit-admin-localstorage.js`, wired into `predeploy`.

**A ratchet, not a wall.** With 45 existing violations an absolute guard would fail every deploy until
the entire backlog cleared — and a gate that blocks everything gets disabled and then ignored. The
default mode fails only when the count **rises**; `--ci` is the absolute form.

**The end state:** when the count reaches zero, switch `predeploy` to `--ci` and the door closes
permanently. Until then the number may fall freely and may never rise. **Never raise the baseline to
make a failure go away** — that single move turns this into decoration.

Mutation-tested: adding `localStorage.getItem('sokoniSecretLedger')` to `moderation.html` reports
`45 -> 46`, names the new key, and fails.

## Recommended order

1. **Financial keys first** — commissions, ledger, tax, costs, booking/lead fees.
2. **Approval-bearing keys** — applications, lawyer/healthcare/driver applications, verified sellers.
   These decide who appears on the platform, and each is a repeat of the Properties defect.
3. **Operational records** — orders, POS, deliveries, disputes, returns, bookings.
4. **Catalogue and content** — products, providers, reviews, community posts, promos.
5. Then switch the guard to `--ci`.
